_meanings:
A grammatical treatise laying down rules for the phonetic
 changes which words in any Śākhā of the Vedas undergo, and teaching the mode

 of pronouncing the accents <ab>&c.</ab> (There exist four Prātiśākhyas, one
 for the Śākala branch of Ṛgveda, one for each of the two branches of
 the Yajurveda, and one for the Atharvaveda.)
